breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the arithmetic-mean area of 300 mm^2 for axial-deformation calculation,' directly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires computing the elongation using the exact integral with the spatially varying A(x), without any arithmetic-mean approximation. The agent failed to remove this incorrect instruction.
